API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APILocation ManagementBulk Delete Locations
Bulk Delete Locations
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/locations/bulkDelete

Bulk delete locations up to a maximum of 100 users per request. The response returns the location IDs that were successfully deleted.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

The location IDs to bulk delete.

ids
int32[]
Responses
​
204
404

Successful Operation
